hypotheses.D1_feature_transfer: Top-mode donor patches have median target-feature preactivation transfer at least 0.15 and exceed norm-matched low-mode patches by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.D2_gate_transfer: At least 25% of formerly inactive recipient features enter the SAE Top-128 gate after top-mode donor patches.
hypotheses.D3_companion_mediation: The frozen 32-feature category core predicts top-mode donor-patch downstream effects with median fidelity at least 0.50.
hypotheses.D4_core_specificity: The own-category 32-feature core exceeds a next-category core by at least 0.20 downstream fidelity.
hypotheses.D5_category_consistency: Top-mode feature-transfer fraction exceeds low-mode transfer for at least four of five categories.
